body.statement: For every \((G_n,Y_n)\in\mathcal M_n(d;B,c)\), \(1\le\lambda_n\le D_n\), \(\lambda_n\ge\sqrt{D_n}\), \(|B_{n,i}|\le\lambda_n-1\), and the oriented matrix satisfies \(\|\mathsf P_n\|_{2\to2}\le\lambda_n\), \(\|\mathsf P_n\|_{4\to4}\le\sqrt{\lambda_nD_n}\), and \(\|\mathsf P_n^{\top}\|_{4\to4}\le\lambda_n\).
body.justification: These inequalities translate Perron priority into the operator norms needed to avoid a squared dependency neighborhood.
body.gap: \cite{KandirosPipisDaskalakisHarshaw2024CGD} uses Perron order for design and variance control but not this \(\ell_4\) martingale chain.
body.consumer: The prefix and operator bounds are the deterministic input to the uniform normal-approximation theorem.
